{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0.00) to counteract overestimation bias.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% for periods with recent price spikes (last 5-7 days) to avoid overshoot.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction: if forecast deviates >15% from 30-day moving average, adjust toward it.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent low prices (last 3-5 days) when sentiment is positive (sentiment > 0.00) to capture rebound potential.",
    "For long-term horizons (>10 days), apply a 10-15% downward bias to account for lagged market adjustments.",
    "When sentiment is positive and price is trending upward, reduce forecast slope to avoid over-optimism.",
    "If true outcome is consistently below forecast, especially after a spike, apply a 10-20% downward correction to prevent overconfidence."
  ]
}
